scope: Verified backport to Next 15.5.28 compiled @vercel/og 0.7.2 Node and edge selector-parser code. Scripts-only implementation; parent owns actual package installation and Worker deployment.

advisories.implementation: Three Set membership passes: unique positions, Sass interpolation filtering, class/id membership.
Upstream 6.1.4 parse/stringify/clone/walk depth guards, Processor option propagation, and non-node serialization compatibility.

patch.failClosed: Exact version plus original/output SHA-256; validate both runtime sources before writing either; unknown source or drift rejects; check-only requires patched hash.
patch.originals: Backed up outside package at .artifacts/vendor-patches/next-15.5.28-og-selector before mutation.
patch.license: MIT text retained in repository and inserted legal comment in both bundles; existing MPL notice retained.

limits.option: Nonnegative safe integer maxNestingDepth is trusted developer configuration and may raise parse/serialize limits, as upstream. Never pass a user value. Invalid values revert to 256.
limits.outsideScope: This is a targeted advisory backport, not a complete upgrade of all OG/Satori dependencies.

checks: Exact original/output hashes, both-file prevalidation, drift/version rejection, idempotence, partial-known completion, originals/metadata preservation
AST own-property data, output and errors match original for ordinary corpus
Actual indexOf scan-work instrumentation verifies removed quadratic passes for flat classes/ids/Sass interpolation
Parse/serialize boundary 256 passes; 257 and 2000 reject with ordinary Error
Programmatically constructed 2000-level trees reject stringify/clone/walk and preserve walk early-stop
Trusted and malformed depth options, sync/async post-transform serialization options
Clone/walk/array coercion compatibility and exact byte preservation after parser/processor boundary

satori.currentRouteReachability: Current GET normalizes bounded title/name text and finite numbers. All user data reaches ordinary text children. BrandSignature SVG elements/attributes and styles are fixed application values; there is no user SVG/element/attribute/style/tw/className input.
satori.limitation: Boundary coverage is not a library-wide Satori fix. Preserve isolation tests; reassess any added SVG/style/image input. Standalone OG replacement deferred pending Worker WASM/font compatibility validation.

compatibility.actualWorkerValidation: Not performed by this subtask; root owns ad-free OpenNext build, packaging and loopback image-response verification.

isolation.researchNetwork: Read-only official upstream GitHub source/advisory and npm package metadata/archive downloads only.

independentReview.scope: Read patch script and all 17 before/after replacements; no confirmed implementation defect found. No independent execution or complete upstream line-by-line comparison performed.
independentReview.limitation: Not a sandbox for arbitrary custom AST objects/getters or attacker-controlled configuration.
